enforcement_note: tests/test_skills.py mechanically enforces the checkable half -- location, the SKILL.md entrypoint and its casing, kebab-case naming, known frontmatter keys, the 500-line body cap, description length, link resolution, and templates/skills/ parity -- and warns past the ~5,000-token compaction budget. It cannot judge whether a skill has one responsibility, whether a description names the situations that should trigger it, or whether the body reads as standing instructions. Those items are review questions and nothing blocks them.
condition: Creating a skill, restructuring one, or moving content between a SKILL.md and its references.
rule: Audit a skill for discoverability, scope, size and frontmatter honesty, as questions.
ai_action: Work through the checklist against the skill in question. Report the answers, including the ones that pass. Where an item is already enforced by tests/test_skills.py, say that the test covers it rather than re-deriving the answer by eye -- and where it is not, do not imply that a green suite settled it.

checklist.question: Is the skill somewhere Claude Code actually discovers -- `.claude/skills/`, `~/.claude/skills/`, or a plugin directory?
checklist.remediation_hint: Move it to .claude/skills/<name>/. Any other directory loads nothing and reports nothing -- every frontmatter field in it is inert.

checklist.question: Does the directory name read as the command you want to type, given that the directory -- not the frontmatter `name` -- supplies it?
checklist.remediation_hint: Rename the directory. In a project skill a `name` that disagrees with it changes only the display label, which reads as a working rename but is not one.

checklist.question: Can you state what this skill is for without saying 'and'?
checklist.source_version: Agent Skills authoring best practices, retrieved 2026-08-06
checklist.remediation_hint: Split it. Two bodies of knowledge that are needed at different moments are two skills, not one skill with two halves.

checklist.question: Is everything left in SKILL.md something that must apply without a second read, with the case-by-case detail moved into `references/`?
checklist.remediation_hint: Move lookup tables, full field references and worked examples out; keep the decision procedure and a map of what each reference holds.
checklist.group_condition: When SKILL.md is approaching either size limit

checklist.question: Is the body inside both limits -- under 500 lines, and under the ~5,000 tokens that survive a compaction?
checklist.remediation_hint: Measure characters, not lines: only the first 5,000 tokens of a skill are re-attached after auto-compaction, and the remainder disappears with no diagnostic. The token limit usually binds first.

checklist.question: Does the description name the situations that should trigger the skill, with the main one first?
checklist.remediation_hint: The description is the only part always in context and the whole basis for automatic invocation. Name the triggering situations concretely; it is truncated at 1,536 characters in the listing.

checklist.question: Is every frontmatter key a documented one, and does each field present change something you can state?
checklist.remediation_hint: An unrecognised key is ignored silently -- `user-invokable` for `user-invocable` does nothing and says nothing. Check it against the documented list, not against memory.

checklist.question: Is the body written as standing instructions rather than one-time steps, given that the content enters context once and is never re-read?
checklist.remediation_hint: Rephrase 'first do X, then Y' guidance that must hold all task long into rules that read correctly on turn ten as well as turn one.

anti_pattern: Do not convert these questions into prescriptions. A question makes you look at the skill and survives a project whose conventions differ; a prescription tells you what to type and stops being right the moment Claude Code's surface moves -- which, for skills, it demonstrably does, version by version.

provenance.source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills; verified 2026-08-06 against Claude Code v2.1.221
provenance.basis: Harvested from a real defect, per GROWTH.md: this repository kept its skills in a repo-root skills/ directory, which Claude Code does not discover, so none of them ever loaded as skills and the disallowed-tools field on autonomous-task was inert. Items phrased as review questions per the checklist-not-prescription rule. The facts behind each item, with citations and check dates, are in .claude/skills/skill-authoring/references/verified-facts.md.
